image_description: A Blenheim spaniel standing in profile on a green grassy lawn. The dog has a white coat with large, distinct chestnut-red patches (Blenheim markings). It features long, heavily feathered ears, a domed head, and a silky coat. The tail is docked and held level with the back. The lighting suggests late afternoon or early evening sunlight.
